== Summary ==
Dennis Shea at the Star Wars CCG Iron Man shredderator. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Dennis Shea]].

Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021227231014im_/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/large/fri05.jpg fri05.jpg] (Wayback 27 December 2002). Caption:
<blockquote>The shredderator. Standing by at the Star Wars CCG Iron Man event, Dan from Carmel, IN, Dennis Shea and Dan from New York City watch as a small appliance with big teeth blends a Boba Fett daiquiri. Ay Caramba!</blockquote>
